title: Regenerate logo (more detailed, similar) and add noticeable bounce animation on page enter/exit

requirements.text: Generate a new Twin Roots Foods logo PNG that is different but visually similar to the user-uploaded reference (image-3.png): keep a circular layout, spice/ingredient line-art elements, earthy color palette, and include the exact text “Twin Roots Foods” and curved tagline text “Rooted in Purity”, but make the overall emblem more detailed. Save it as a static asset under frontend/public/assets/generated/ and do not serve it via the backend.

quotes:

i am attaching again, plase make it different but similar

1.circular layout, spice elements, earthy colors, tagline text

2.more detailed design

3.Yes

acceptanceCriteria: A new PNG logo asset exists under frontend/public/assets/generated/ with the filename specified in the image requirements.
The logo keeps a circular emblem with spice/ingredient line-art and an earthy palette, and is more detailed than the current logo.
The logo text reads exactly “Twin Roots Foods” and the tagline reads exactly “Rooted in Purity” (spelling/case/punctuation match).

requirements.text: Update the site header logo image to use the newly generated logo asset instead of the current /assets/generated/logo-v4.dim_512x512.png.

quotes:
Still compeney logo same showing:

i am attaching again, plase make it different but similar

acceptanceCriteria: Header renders the new logo asset (not logo-v4).
Header logo alt text remains in English and remains appropriate for the brand (e.g., “Twin Roots Foods”).

requirements.text: Add a footer logo image (using the same newly generated logo asset) in the footer branding area near the “Twin Roots Foods” text so the footer has a logo to animate as requested.
acceptanceCriteria: Footer displays the new logo image alongside the existing footer brand text/tagline.
The footer remains responsive and does not break the existing footer grid layout.

requirements.text: Implement a noticeable bounce animation for the logo on both the header and footer: the bounce must play when the user visits/loads a page and also when navigating between internal pages (i.e., on route changes).

quotes: Yes-Add animation (Bounce) on logo when visit the site and exit the each page

acceptanceCriteria: On initial page load, the header logo and footer logo each play a noticeable bounce animation once.
On internal navigation (changing routes within the SPA), the header logo and footer logo each play the bounce animation again.
Animation is applied to the logo image element(s) only (not the whole header/footer containers).
All user-facing text remains English (no new non-English strings introduced as part of this change).

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui/*.
Store and reference the logo as a static asset under frontend/public/assets/generated; do not serve images via the backend.
Keep the brand texts exactly: “Twin Roots Foods” and “Rooted in Purity”.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: No changes to product catalog, checkout, orders, or export inquiry behavior.
No additional animations beyond the requested logo bounce on page enter and internal navigation/exit.

required: Detailed circular spice/ingredient line-art emblem in an earthy palette with integrated brand text “Twin Roots Foods” and curved tagline “Rooted in Purity” (logo-v5.dim_512x512.png)
